description_en: Modifies the log field configuration of a protected object
description_zh: 修改防护对象的日志字段配置
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-resource-log-field-config --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-uax00003k0e --field-list account,acl_action,acl_rule_id,acl_rule_type,acl_test,antiscan_action,antiscan_rule_id,antiscan_rule_type,antiscan_test,body_bytes_sent,bypass_matched_ids --delivery-type sls --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource cwaf-000-waf --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyResourceLogFieldConfig

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of log fields to deliver. Specify the fields in the "a,b,c,..." format.

All required log fields must be included. You can invoke the [DescribeCommonLogFields](~~DescribeCommonLogFields~~) operation to view the log fields supported by Simple Log Service for WAF. 
If the log fields include request_header, use the delivery extension configuration (ExtendConfig) parameter to specify the request headers to deliver
parameters.help_zh:
需投递的日志字段列表。使用"a,b,c,……"格式表示。

需要包含所有必选日志字段, 您可以通过调用[DescribeCommonLogFields](~~DescribeCommonLogFields~~)接口查看WAF日志服务支持的日志字段信息。 
当日志字段中包含request_header时，需要使用投递扩展配置（ExtendConfig）参数指定需要投递的请求头
parameters.name: field_list

parameters.help_en:
The log delivery extension configuration. The value is a string converted from a JSON object constructed with a series of parameters.
For more information, see the Log delivery extension configuration parameter description
parameters.help_zh:
日志投递扩展配置。以一系列参数构造的 JSON 格式转化成字符串。
详细信息，请参见日志投递扩展配置参数描述
parameters.name: extend_config

parameters.help_en:
The log delivery type. Valid values:

sls: Simple Log Service.
kafka: external delivery to Kafka logs.
syslog: external delivery to Syslog logs
parameters.help_zh:
日志投递类型。取值：

sls： 表示阿里云日志服务。
kafka：表示外发投递到kafka日志。
syslog：表示外发投递到syslog日志
parameters.name: delivery_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The log delivery strategy. Multiple strategies are supported. The value is a string converted from a JSON array constructed with a series of parameters.

For more information, see the Log delivery strategy parameter description
parameters.help_zh:
日志投递策略，支持多个策略。以一系列参数构造的 JSON 数组格式转化成字符串。

详细信息，请参见日志投递策略参数描述
parameters.name: log_delivery_strategy
